desc: Derive/verify the closed form: answer = C(m·n−2, k−2) · [ n²·(m³−m)/6 + m²·(n³−n)/6 ], hand-checked against m=n=k=2 → 8 and m=1,n=4,k=3 → 20.
Implement `distanceSum`: modular factorial/inverse-factorial tables up to m·n, nCr helper (0 when out of range), exact-int T(t), and final multiplication mod 1e9+7.

Verify the finished code on the two given examples plus edge cases (m=1 or n=1, k=2, k=m·n, m·n=2) — all handled by the formula (T(1)=0, C(mn−2,0)=C(mn−2,mn−2)=1), factorial table floored at size 2 for safe indexing.
Sanity-check runtime/memory for m·n = 10^5: single O(mn) factorial/inverse-factorial build plus O(1) arithmetic — well within limits.
